DA_18_Akali_AD.text: Adaptor AD: Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing 145/220/380% AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage. If the target is Burning, deal an additional 35/52/80% AD damage. Adaptor AP: If the Ability kills, cast it again.

DA_18_Camille.text: Slice the target for 160/240/410% AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage and gain 60/90/200 Shield for 2 seconds.

DA_Cinderling18.text: Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of 310/465/700% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage and applying 20% Wound and 1% Burn for 4 seconds. Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains 22% Attack Damage each cast. Wound: Reduces healing received. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.

DA_Karma18.text: Tether the current target, dealing 280/420/630 AP magic damage over 1.5 seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing 125/185/300 AP magic damage to all enemies in a 1 Hex radius and 30% Slowing them for 2 seconds. Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

DA_18_Kobuko.text: Restore 265/315/460 AP + 7% HP max Health Health over 2 seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals 10% HP max Health + 70/105/150 AP magic damage.

DA_18_Leona.text: Passive: Start combat with 60/80/100 AP bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over 12 seconds. Active: Bash the current target, dealing 150/270/405% Armor magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

DA_18_Ornn.text: Active: Gain 400/460/550 AP Shield for 4 seconds and deal 200/300/450 AP magic damage to enemies in a cone. Quest: Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, increased by 85% at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power.

DA_18_Sentry.text: Begin consuming 35% max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal 160/240/360 AP magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by 3. Teal Buff: Gain 2 Mana Regen for every 4 seconds channeled.

DA_18_Rakan.text: Gain 270/320/415 AP Shield for 4 seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat 1.9/2/2.3 AP + 1 AP decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

DA_18_RekSai.text: Passive: Restore 10/14/20 Health each second, tripled for 3 seconds after casting. Active: Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for 1 second and dealing 70/105/160 AP magic damage to them.

DA_18_Varus.text: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals 415/625/1000% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by 40% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 40%).

DA_18_Veigar.text: Launch a giant blast at the target that deals 200/300/450 AP magic damage, increased to 300/450/675 AP if they're below 30% max Health. If they die, permanently gain 2% Ability Power.

DA_18_Xayah.text: Gain 50% Attack Speed for the next 5 attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal 68/102/155% AD physical damage and reduce Armor by 2 AP.

DA_18_Yorick.text: Passive: On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with 200/400/750 + 20% HP max Health max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it. Active: Restore 280/325/435 AP Health and strike the target, dealing 150/225/340 AP physical damage.

DA_18_Alistar.text: Roar, restoring 8% HP max Health Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for 80/105/130 AP. Then slam the current target, dealing 180/270/420 AP magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

DA_18_Caitlyn.text: Passive: Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals 190/285/470% AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage.

DA_18_Elise.text: Transform into a spider and gain 375/475/725 max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal 35/50/80 AP bonus magic damage and heal for 55/90/170 AP. Subsequent casts grant 175% decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

DA_Gromp18_AP.text: Adaptor AP: Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225/340/535 AP magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take 175/265/410 AP magic damage over 3 seconds. Adaptor AD: Heavily slows the target. Purple Buff: Every 5 seconds, Gromp gains 30% Ability Power.

DA_18_Kayle.text: Passive: Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 1st Ascension: Attacks deal 62/92/105 AP bonus magic damage. 2nd Ascension: Attacks 20% Shred enemies hit for 2 seconds. 3rd Ascension: Attacks fire waves, dealing 35 AP magic damage to all other units hit. 4th Ascension: Gain infinite range. Every 3rd wave is much larger. Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

DA_18_LeBlanc.text: Passive: After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a 10/15/40% chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by 4% per takedown. Active: Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing 260/390/615 AP magic damage and 100/150/230 AP to adjacent enemies.

DA_Murkwolf18.text: Leap to the lowest Health enemy within 3 Hexes and deal 100/150/225% AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage. The next 2 attacks gain 175% Attack Speed and deal 65/100/160% AD bonus physical damage. Grey Buff: Gain Precision and 25% Critical Strike Chance, increased up to 75% based on missing Health.

DA_Scuttlecrab18.text: Passive: Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals 50/75/112.5% AD physical damage to all adjacent enemies. Active: Burrow underground, gaining 15% Durability for 3 seconds and healing 325/400/675 AP over the duration. Green Buff: When allies fall below 50% Health, they restore 15% max Health.

DA_18_Sejuani.text: Gain 225/250/275 AP + 10% HP max Health Shield for 4 seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing 90/135/205 AP magic damage and strike in a line, dealing 120/180/270 AP magic damage to enemies hit.

DA_18_Shen.text: Grant 350/430/550 AP Shield to Shen and 200/275/375 AP Shield to a nearby damaged ally for 4 seconds. Both of their next 3 attacks gain 40% Attack Speed and deal 35/55/80 AP bonus magic damage.

DA_18_Teemo.text: Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal 60/90/135 AP magic damage to the 3 nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals 135/200/310 AP magic damage to the target. Each cast has a 10/12/15% chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects. Red: 1 Reroll Green: 1 Tactician Health Yellow: 2 XP

DA_18_Warwick.text: Bite the current target, dealing 230/345/535% AD physical damage and healing for 25% AP of the damage dealt. Gain 20% Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

DA_18_Yunara.text: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals 160/240/370% AD physical damage and splits, dealing 35% of 160/240/370% AD physical damage to 2 nearby enemies.

DA_18_Azir.text: Gain 150% Attack Speed and summon 2 soldiers for the next 6 attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal 46/69/110 AP magic damage per attack.

DA_18_Cassiopeia.text: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing 420/630/1020 AP magic damage over 15 seconds. Poisons stack.

DA_18_Diana.text: Gain 150/275/500 shield for 2 seconds and send out 6 moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing 75/115/180 AP magic damage.

DA_Fiddlesticks18.text: Reduce the Magic Resist of the 3 nearest enemies by 10. Then drain life from them over 2 seconds, healing for 410/485/850 AP Health and dealing 70/105/170 AP magic damage to each over the duration.

DA_18_Hecarim.text: Gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore 375/475/685 AP Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the 3 nearest enemies, dealing 80/120/195 AP magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5/1.5/1.75 seconds.

DA_18_KhaZix.text: Leap to the farthest enemy within 3 Hexes, dealing 285/400/580 AP magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal 310/445/660 AP magic damage instead and gain 10 mana.

DA_KogMaw18_AD.text: Adaptor AD: Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing 145/220/375% AD + 20/30/50 AP physical damage. Enemies below 50% max Health take 140% of 145/220/375% AD + 20/30/50 AP physical damage instead. AdaptorAP: Damages enemies over time.

DA_Krug18.text: Passive: On death, split into two Kruglettes with 50/100/180 + 12% HP max Health Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them. Active: Gain 175/225/325 AP max Health, then roll into the target, dealing 135/200/335% AD + 8% HP max Health damage. Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for 8% max Health.

DA_18_MasterYi_AD.text: Passive: Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed. Adaptor AD: Double Strikes grant 12% + 3% AP stacking Attack Speed. Adaptor AP: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.

DA_18_Rammus.text: Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For 4 seconds, gain 400/550/725 AP Shield and 60 Armor and Magic Resist. When the Shield breaks, deal 50/75/120% Armor + 50/75/120% MR physical damage to enemies in 2 Hexes.

DA_CrimsonRaptor18.text: Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks nearby for 5 AP seconds. Whenever Mama Beak attacks, Tiny Beaks attack the same enemy, dealing 22/33/48% AD physical damage. Orange Buff: Dealing physical damage reduces enemy Armor by 2.

DA_18_Rengar.text: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within 3 hexes and stab them, dealing 255/385/615% AD physical damage. Then heal for 60/90/90 AP, increased to up to 120/180/180 AP based on their missing Health.

DA_18_Tristana.text: Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts 4 seconds. While active, gain infinite range and 40% + 20% AP Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing 160/240/385% AD physical damage + 10/15/25% AD for each attack while casting. If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.

DA_Vi18.text: Passive: On attack, restore 2% HP max Health Health. Active: Unleash a primal roar, restoring 200/265/360 AP Health. Then gain 85/100/125% Attack Speed, 15% Durability, and is Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

DA_18_Ahri.text: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within 4 hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals 455/685/3500 AP magic damage to enemies in a 3 hex radius, reduced by 21% per hex away from the epicenter.

DA_Amumu18.text: Passive: Every second, restore 2.5/2.5/4% HP + 20/25/100 AP Health and deal 12/18/150 AP magic damage to enemies within 1 hex. Active: Deal 100/150/2000 AP magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for 1/1/6 seconds, increased to 1/1/6 seconds if the target is Burning. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.

DA_Sentinel18.text: Gain 350/450/2000 AP + 10% HP max Health Shield for 4 seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take 100/150/3500 AP magic damage, and are Mana Reaved for 10. Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain 2 Mana Regen. Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.

DA_18_Aphelios.text: Equip Severum and swipe the target 5 times over 2 seconds, each dealing 70/105/850% AD physical damage. After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals 450/675/5000% AD + 40/60/225 AP physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

DA_Brambleback18.text: Passive: When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing 155/235/1000% AD physical damage. Active: Gain 80/80/300% Attack Damage for 8 seconds. During this time ignore 20% Armor. Red Buff: Attacks 1% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for 4% max Health.

DA_18_Ezreal.text: Blink away from the current target, deal 250/375/1200% AD physical damage to them, and gain 30/30/100% AP Attack Speed. Every 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Nature's Wrath and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals 385/580/2500% AD physical damage, reduced by 25% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 50%).

DA_18_Lillia.text: Restore 350/525/800 AP Health and send 4 butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take 90/135/2000 AP magic damage and Sleep for 1.5/1.75/8 seconds. If they take 1000 damage, they wake up and take an additional 10% max Health magic damage.

DA_18_Malphite.text: Gain 700/850/2000 AP Shield for 4 seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing 30/45/999% MR + 30/45/999% Armor + 40/60/2000 AP magic damage to enemies within 2/2/3 hexes.

DA_18_Morgana.text: Passive: Gain 25% Omnivamp. Active: Fire a dark blast at 3 nearby enemies, dealing 60/90/500 AP magic damage to them and cursing them for 4 seconds. Then, spawn a 2 Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals 33/50/500 AP magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take 22/33/240 AP more damage per curse.

DA_Nidalee18_AP.text: Adaptor AP: Gain 150% Attack Speed for the next 3 attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal 170/255/2000 AP magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals 330/500/3000 AP magic damage. Adaptor AD: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.

DA_18_Sett.text: Passive: Upon falling below 40% max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana. Active: Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for 12% HP + 225/275/2000 AP before dealing 150/225/5000% AD + 6% HP max Health physical damage in a large cone.

DA_18_Sivir.text: Throw a large crossblade that deals 190/285/1050% AD + 15/20/100 AP physical damage to the current target and bounces 8 times between nearby enemies, dealing 20/20/40% of 190/285/1050% AD + 15/20/100 AP physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce 3/3/6 additional times.

DA_18_Soraka.text: Call down a star on the current target, dealing 225/335/1000 AP magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down 3 additional stars that each deal 100/150/1000 AP magic damage.

DA_18_Zyra.text: Spawn 2/2/4 plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy 10 times. Each attack deals 35/53/225 AP magic damage.

DA_18_Alune.text: Rain 9 moonshards split among the 3 nearest enemies, dealing 55/83/500 AP magic damage each. If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing 2350/3600/7500 AP magic damage split among all enemies.

DA_18_Ashe.text: Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals 465/700/1000% AD physical damage, reduced by 80/80/40% per enemy hit (minimum 20%). The arrow leaves a trail for 4/4/20 seconds that deals 5/8/200% AD + 2/3/10% max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and 20% Slows them. Slow: Reduce Attack Speed

DA_Draven18.text: Passive: Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals 140/210/3000% AD physical damage over 12 seconds. Every attack has a 12% AP chance to deal 50/50/900% bonus physical damage and apply 2 bleeds instead. Active: Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal 100/150/400% AD physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing 30/45/100% AD physical damage to enemies hit.

DA_18_ElderDragon.text: Passive: Attacks deal 75/75/100% damage to enemies adjacent to the target. Active: Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for 1.25/1.25/99 seconds, gain 15/15/100% Omnivamp, and Ignite them for 3/3/99 seconds. Ignited enemies take 2/2/20% max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it. Flame Breath: Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing 285/435/7000% AD + 20/30/200 AP physical damage, reduced by 20% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 20%.) Ignite those enemies for 3/3/99 seconds. Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below 12% Health executes them.

DA_18_GnarSmall.text: Passive: Gain 5/5/50 Rage per second and 5/5/20 Rage per attack. Active: Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within 3 hexes. Then, deal 100/150/2000% AD physical damage to enemies within 2/2/10 hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by 15/20/250 AP, and Stun them for 1/1/15 second. Mega Gnar gains 400/600/15000 Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw. Grab n' Throw: Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing 380/570/9000% AD physical damage to them and 135/205/4500% AD physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

DA_18_Ivern.text: Passive: Shields from this Ability can critically strike with Precision. Active: Grant 2/2/10 allies 185/350/3000 AP Shield and 10/15/100% Damage Amp for 6 seconds. Then deal 155/235/2000 AP magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting 6 times, also grant 100% stacking Attack Speed to targets.

DA_18_Kennen.text: Charge up, gaining 15% Ability Power per Burning enemy. Then, gain 250/350/3000 AP Shield for 2.5 seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing 80/120/1500 AP magic damage to each. After rushing, unleash a 2 Hex firestorm that deals a total of 475/715/5000 AP magic damage split among all enemies hit over 2 seconds.

DA_18_Maokai.text: Passive: After every 650/650/300 damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals 7/7/75% HP max Health magic damage. On death, 3/5/10 saplings jump out. Active: Deal 6/6/100% HP max Health magic damage to target and restore 330/400/2000 AP + 10/10/100% missing Health.

DA_Taric18.text: Passive: The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below 50% Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting 75/150/10000 + 15/15/100% HP max Health Shield to allies within 3 Hexes for 3/3/99 seconds. Active: Restore 275/450/3000 AP Health. Taric and his paired ally deal 100/150/1000 AP bonus magic damage on their next 2 attacks.

DA_Lux18_Base.text: Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain 3/3/100 AP mana. Active: Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals 375/565/6500 AP magic damage, reduced by 25/25/10% for each enemy hit.

DA_BrambleVest.name: Bramble Vest

DA_Evenshroud.name: Evenshroud
DA_Evenshroud.desc: 30% Sunder enemies within 2 hexes. Gain 15 Armor and Magic Resist for the first 15 seconds of combat. Sunder: Reduce Armor

DA_GargoyleStoneplate.name: Gargoyle Stoneplate

DA_GiantSlayer.name: Giant Slayer
DA_GiantSlayer.desc: Gain 15% additional Damage Amp against Tanks.

DA_GuinsoosRageblade.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade
DA_GuinsoosRageblade.desc: Gain 7% stacking Attack Speed every second.

DA_HextechGunblade.name: Hextech Gunblade
DA_HextechGunblade.desc: Heal the lowest percent Health ally for 20% of damage dealt. Ally Healing: <tftattribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1" precision="0"/>

DA_InfinityEdge.desc: Gain Precision . Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Extra Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

DA_IonicSpark.name: Ionic Spark
DA_IonicSpark.desc: 30% Shred enemies within 2 hexes. When enemies cast an Ability, deal magic damage equal to 150% of the Mana spent. Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

DA_JeweledGauntlet.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
DA_JeweledGauntlet.desc: Gain Precision . Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Extra Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

DA_KrakensFury.name: Kraken's Fury
DA_KrakensFury.desc: Attacks grant 3.5% stacking Attack Damage, up to 15 attacks. After 15 attacks, gain 15% Attack Speed.

DA_LastWhisper.name: Last Whisper
DA_LastWhisper.desc: Attacks and Ability damage 30% Sunders the target for 3 seconds. This effect does not stack. Sunder: Reduce Armor

DA_Morellonomicon.name: Morellonomicon
DA_Morellonomicon.desc: Attacks and Abilities deal 1% Burn and 33% Wound to enemies for 10 seconds. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second. Wound: Reduces healing received.

DA_NashorsTooth.name: Nashor's Tooth
DA_NashorsTooth.desc: Attacks grant 2 bonus Mana, increased to 2 + 2 if they critically strike.

DA_ProtectorsVow.name: Protector's Vow
DA_ProtectorsVow.desc: Combat Start: Gain 20 Mana. At 40% Health, gain 15 Mana and a Shield equal to 20% max Health.

DA_Quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
DA_Quicksilver.desc: Combat Start: Unstoppable for 18 seconds. Gain 3% stacking Attack Speed every second.

DA_RabadonsDeathcap.name: Rabadon's Deathcap
DA_RabadonsDeathcap.desc: This humble hat can help you make, or unmake, the world itself. {ItemTags.RabadonsDeathcap.DeadlierCapsStacks}

DA_RedBuff.name: Red Buff
DA_RedBuff.desc: Attacks and Abilities 1% Burn and 33% Wound enemies for 5 seconds. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second. Wound: Reduces healing received.

DA_SpiritVisage.name: Spirit Visage
DA_SpiritVisage.desc: Regenerate 2% of missing Health each second.

DA_SteadfastHeart.name: Steadfast Heart
DA_SteadfastHeart.desc: Gain 5% Durability. While above 50% Health, instead gain 15% Durability.{Augment.Variant.HeartofSteel.Tooltip}

DA_SteraksGage.name: Sterak's Gage
DA_SteraksGage.desc: At 60% Health, gain a Shield equal to 40% of the wearer's maximum Health that rapidly decays over 4 seconds.

DA_StrikersFlail.name: Striker's Flail
DA_StrikersFlail.desc: Critical Strikes grant 5% Damage Amp for 5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

DA_SunfireCape.name: Sunfire Cape
DA_SunfireCape.desc: Gain 8% max Health. Every 2 seconds, deal 1% Burn and 33% Wound to an enemy within 2 hexes for 10 seconds. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second. Wound: Reduces healing received.

DA_ThiefsGloves.name: Thief's Gloves
DA_ThiefsGloves.desc: Each round: Equip 2 random items [Consumes 3 item slots.]

DA_TitansResolve.name: Titan's Resolve
DA_TitansResolve.desc: Gain 2% Attack Damage and Ability Power when attacking or taking damage, stacking up to 25 times. At full stacks, gain 10% Damage Amp and become Unstoppable.

DA_VoidStaff.name: Void Staff
DA_VoidStaff.desc: Attacks and Ability damage 30% Shred the target for 5 seconds. This effect does not stack. Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

DA_ArchangelsStaffRadiant.name: Radiant Archangel's Staff
DA_ArchangelsStaffRadiant.desc: Combat start: Gain <colorradiant>40</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> Ability Power every 5 seconds in combat.

DA_BloodthirsterRadiant.name: Radiant Bloodthirster
DA_BloodthirsterRadiant.desc: Once per combat at 50% Health, gain a <colorradiant>60%</colorradiant> max Health Shield that lasts up to 5 seconds.

DA_BlueBuffRadiant.name: Radiant Blue Buff
DA_BlueBuffRadiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>20%</colorradiant> additional Attack Damage and Ability Power from all sources.

DA_BrambleVestRadiant.name: Radiant Bramble Vest
DA_BrambleVestRadiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>12%</colorradiant> max Health. Take <colorradiant>10%</colorradiant> reduced damage from attacks. When struck by any attack, deal <colorradiant>200</colorradiant> magic damage to all adjacent enemies. Cooldown: 2 seconds

DA_CrownguardRadiant.name: Radiant Crownguard
DA_CrownguardRadiant.desc: Combat start: Gain a <colorradiant>50</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> max Health Shield for 8 seconds. When the shield expires, gain <colorradiant>50</colorradiant><colorradiant>% Ability Power</colorradiant>.

DA_DeathbladeRadiant.name: Radiant Deathblade
DA_DeathbladeRadiant.desc: It glows in the presence of enemies. Or friends. Or anything alive, really. {ItemTags.Deathblade.DeadlierBladeStacks}

DA_DragonsClawRadiant.name: Radiant Dragon's Claw
DA_DragonsClawRadiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>28%</colorradiant> max Health. Every 2 seconds, heal <colorradiant>5%</colorradiant> max Health.

DA_EdgeOfNightRadiant.name: Radiant Edge of Night
DA_EdgeOfNightRadiant.desc: At 40% Health, briefly become untargetable, shed negative effects, and <colorradiant>heal all missing health</colorradiant>.

DA_EvenshroudRadiant.name: Radiant Evenshroud
DA_EvenshroudRadiant.desc: 30% Sunder enemies within 3 hexes. Gain <colorradiant>50</colorradiant> <colorradiant>Armor and Magic Resist</colorradiant> for the first <colorradiant>20</colorradiant> <colorradiant>seconds</colorradiant> of combat. Sunder: Reduce Armor

DA_GargoyleStoneplate_Radiant.name: Radiant Gargoyle Stoneplate
DA_GargoyleStoneplate_Radiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>20</colorradiant> Armor and <colorradiant>20</colorradiant> Magic Resist for each enemy targeting the holder.

DA_GiantSlayer_Radiant.name: Radiant Giant Slayer
DA_GiantSlayer_Radiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>30%</colorradiant> additional Damage Amp against Tanks.

DA_GuinsoosRagebladeRadiant.name: Radiant Guinsoo's Rageblade
DA_GuinsoosRagebladeRadiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>16</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> stacking Attack Speed every second.

DA_HandOfJusticeRadiant.name: Radiant Hand of Justice
DA_HandOfJusticeRadiant.desc: Gain 2 effects: • <colorradiant>35%</colorradiant> Attack Damage and <colorradiant>35%</colorradiant> Ability Power. • <colorradiant>30%</colorradiant> Omnivamp. While above 50% health, double the Attack Damage and Ability Power. While below 50% Health, double the Omnivamp.

DA_HextechGunbladeRadiant.name: Radiant Hextech Gunblade
DA_HextechGunbladeRadiant.desc: Heal the lowest percent Health ally for <colorradiant>40%</colorradiant> of damage dealt. Ally Healing: <tftattribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1" precision="0"/>

DA_InfinityEdgeRadiant.name: Radiant Infinity Edge
DA_InfinityEdgeRadiant.desc: Gain Precision . Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Extra Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

DA_IonicSparkRadiant.name: Radiant Ionic Spark
DA_IonicSparkRadiant.desc: 30% Shred enemies within 2 hexes. When enemies cast an Ability, deal magic damage equal to <colorradiant>300%</colorradiant> of the Mana spent. Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

DA_JeweledGauntletRadiant.name: Radiant Jeweled Gauntlet
DA_JeweledGauntletRadiant.desc: Gain Precision . Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Extra Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

DA_KrakensFury_Radiant.name: Radiant Kraken's Fury
DA_KrakensFury_Radiant.desc: Attacks grant <colorradiant>7</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> stacking Attack Damage, up to 15 attacks. After 15 attacks, gain <colorradiant>30%</colorradiant> Attack Speed.

DA_LastWhisperRadiant.name: Radiant Last Whisper
DA_LastWhisperRadiant.desc: Attacks and Ability damage 30% Sunders the target for the <colorradiant>rest of combat.</colorradiant> This effect does not stack. Sunder: Reduce Armor

DA_RadiantLuckyItemChest.name: Radiant Lucky Item Chest
DA_RadiantLuckyItemChest.desc: Use on a champion to open an armory of items especially suited for them. These items are based on the champion's recommended items.

DA_MorellonomiconRadiant.name: Radiant Morellonomicon
DA_MorellonomiconRadiant.desc: Attacks and Abilities deal <colorradiant>2</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> Burn and 33% Wound to enemies for 10 seconds. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second. Wound: Reduces healing received.

DA_NashorsToothRadiant.name: Radiant Nashor's Tooth
DA_NashorsToothRadiant.desc: Attacks grant <colorradiant>4</colorradiant> bonus Mana, increased to <colorradiant>4 + 2</colorradiant> if they critically strike.

DA_ProtectorsVowRadiant.name: Radiant Protector's Vow
DA_ProtectorsVowRadiant.desc: Combat Start: Gain <colorradiant>40</colorradiant> Mana. At 40% Health, gain <colorradiant>30</colorradiant> <colorradiant>Mana</colorradiant> and a Shield equal to <colorradiant>50%</colorradiant> <colorradiant>max Health</colorradiant>

DA_QuicksilverRadiant.name: Radiant Quicksilver
DA_QuicksilverRadiant.desc: Combat Start: Unstoppable for <colorradiant>45</colorradiant> seconds. Gain <colorradiant>6%</colorradiant> stacking Attack Speed every second.

DA_RabadonsDeathcap_Radiant.name: Radiant Rabadon's Deathcap
DA_RabadonsDeathcap_Radiant.desc: It's witnessed - and unleashed - miracles and calamities both. {ItemTags.RabadonsDeathcap.DeadlierCapsStacks}

DA_RedBuffRadiant.name: Radiant Red Buff
DA_RedBuffRadiant.desc: Attacks and Abilities <colorradiant>2</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> Burn and 33% Wound enemies for 5 seconds. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second. Wound: Reduces healing received.

DA_SpiritVisage_Radiant.name: Radiant Spirit Visage
DA_SpiritVisage_Radiant.desc: Regenerate <colorradiant>4</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> of missing Health each second.

DA_SteadfastHeartRadiant.name: Radiant Steadfast Heart
DA_SteadfastHeartRadiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>10</colorradiant>% Durability. While above 50% Health, instead gain <colorradiant>30</colorradiant>% Durability.{Augment.Variant.HeartofSteel.Tooltip}

DA_SteraksGageRadiant.name: Radiant Sterak's Gage
DA_SteraksGageRadiant.desc: At 60% Health, gain a Shield equal to <colorradiant>80%</colorradiant> of the wearer's maximum Health that rapidly decays over <colorradiant>6</colorradiant> seconds.

DA_StrikersFlailRadiant.name: Radiant Striker's Flail
DA_StrikersFlailRadiant.desc: Critical Strikes grant <colorradiant>10%</colorradiant> Damage Amp for 5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

DA_SunfireCape_Radiant.name: Radiant Sunfire Cape
DA_SunfireCape_Radiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>16%</colorradiant> max Health. Every 2 seconds, deal <colorradiant>2</colorradiant><colorradiant>%</colorradiant> Burn and 33% Wound to an enemy within 2 hexes for 10 seconds. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second. Wound: Reduces healing received.

DA_ThiefsGlovesRadiant.name: Radiant Thief's Gloves
DA_ThiefsGlovesRadiant.desc: Each round: Equip 2 random <colorradiant>Radiant</colorradiant> items [Consumes 3 item slots.]

DA_TitansResolve_Radiant.name: Radiant Titan's Resolve
DA_TitansResolve_Radiant.desc: Gain <colorradiant>4%</colorradiant> Attack Damage and <colorradiant>4%</colorradiant> Ability Power when attacking or taking damage, stacking up to 25 times. At full stacks, gain <colorradiant>20</colorradiant>% Damage Amp and Unstoppable.

DA_VoidStaffRadiant.name: Radiant Void Staff
DA_VoidStaffRadiant.desc: Attacks and Ability damage 30% Shred the target for the <colorradiant>rest of combat.</colorradiant> This effect does not stack. Shred: Reduce Magic Resist

DA_Artifact_AegisOfDawn.name: Aegis of Dawn
DA_Artifact_AegisOfDawn.desc: Every 2.5 seconds, steal 3 Armor from enemies within 1-hex and heal 20% of the holder's Armor. If Aegis of Dusk is also equipped, trigger this item's effect every 1.25 seconds instead. Healing increases based on Stage.

DA_Artifact_AegisOfDusk.name: Aegis of Dusk
DA_Artifact_AegisOfDusk.desc: Every 2.5 seconds, steal 3 Magic Resist from enemies within 1-hex and deal 18% of the holder's Magic Resist as magic damage. If Aegis of Dawn is also equipped, trigger this item's effect every 1.25 seconds instead. Damage increases based on Stage.

DA_Artifact_BlightingJewel.name: Blighting Jewel
DA_Artifact_BlightingJewel.desc: Dealing magic damage reduces the target’s Magic Resist by 3. If their Magic Resist is 0, grant the holder 4 Mana instead. Ability damage can only trigger on each enemy once every 0.5 seconds.

DA_Artifact_Dawncore.name: Dawncore
DA_Artifact_Dawncore.desc: Reduce the holder's max Mana by 10. Subsequent spellcasts reduce max Mana by 5%, to a minimum of 15.

DA_Artifact_DeathsDefiance.name: Death's Defiance
DA_Artifact_DeathsDefiance.desc: <tftcurvetable row="DamageToDefer"/>% of the damage the holder receives is instead dealt over <tftcurvetable row="DamageOverTimeDuration"/> seconds as non-lethal damage. Unique - only 1 per champion

DA_Artifact_EternalPact.name: Eternal Pact
DA_Artifact_EternalPact.desc: Combat start: Form a pact with the highest Health allied champion, If they die, gain 10 Mana regen and 40% Ability Power. When the ally uses their ability, gain 15 Mana. Every 6 seconds, shield your ally for 200% of the holder's Ability Power.

DA_Artifact_Fishbones.name: Fishbones
DA_Artifact_Fishbones.desc: The holder's attacks target random enemies. Gain +2 Attack Range.

DA_Artifact_NavoriFlickerblade.name: Flickerblades
DA_Artifact_NavoriFlickerblade.desc: Attacks grant 4% stacking Attack Speed. Every 3 attacks also grant 2% Attack Damage and 2% Ability Power.

DA_Artifact_ForbiddenIdol.name: Forbidden Idol
DA_Artifact_ForbiddenIdol.desc: Shields have 40% of their value converted to max Health instead.

DA_Artifact_GamblersBlade.name: Gambler's Blade
DA_Artifact_GamblersBlade.desc: Grant 1% bonus Attack Speed per gold in your bank (up to 30 gold). Each attack has a 6% chance to drop 1 gold. Gold generated this game: <tftattribute attributeId="TFTItemAttributes.Stack" icon="Icon.Coin"/> Unique - only 1 per champion

DA_Artifact_GoldCollector.name: Gold Collector
DA_Artifact_GoldCollector.desc: Attacks and Abilities execute enemies below 12% of their maximum Health. Executions on champions have a 33% chance to drop 1 gold. Gold collected: <tftattribute attributeId="TFTItemAttributes.Stack" icon="Icon.Coin"/> Unique - only 1 per champion

DA_Artifact_HellfireHatchet.name: Hellfire Hatchet
DA_Artifact_HellfireHatchet.desc: Attacks deal 3% of the holder's max Health as bonus physical damage. For every 1% missing Health, gain 1.5% Attack Speed.

DA_Artifact_HorizonFocus.name: Horizon Focus
DA_Artifact_HorizonFocus.desc: Stunning an enemy causes lightning to strike them, dealing 30% of their max Health as magic damage.

DA_Artifact_Hullcrusher.name: Hullcrusher
DA_Artifact_Hullcrusher.desc: Combat Start: If there are no adjacent allies, gain 400 Health, 10% Attack Damage, and 10% Ability Power.

DA_Artifact_LichBane.name: Lich Bane
DA_Artifact_LichBane.desc: The holder’s first attack after each Ability cast deals 250/350/500/600/700/700 bonus magic damage. Damage increases based on Stage.

DA_Artifact_LightshieldCrest.name: Lightshield Crest
DA_Artifact_LightshieldCrest.desc: Every 3 seconds, Shields the lowest percent Health ally for 70% of the holder’s combined Armor and Magic Resist for 5 seconds. On death grants this shield to all allies.

DA_Artifact_LudensTempest.name: Luden's Tempest
DA_Artifact_LudensTempest.desc: 100% of overkill damage plus 130 is dealt as magic damage to the two enemies nearest the target.

DA_Artifact_Manazane.name: Manazane
DA_Artifact_Manazane.desc: After casting the first time in combat, gain 110 Mana over 5 seconds.

DA_Artifact_Mittens.name: Mittens
DA_Artifact_Mittens.desc: Shrinks the holder, granting them increased movement speed and immunity to Slow, Burn, and Wound. Slow: Reduces Attack Speed. Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second. Wound: Reduces healing received.

DA_Artifact_MogulsMail.name: Mogul'sMail
DA_Artifact_MogulsMail.desc: Grants 1 Armor, 1 Magic Resist, and 5 Health when taking damage, stacking up to 35 times. At full stacks, grant 1 gold and continue gaining 1 gold every 11 seconds. Gold generated this game: <tftattribute attributeId="TFTItemAttributes.Stack2"/> Unique - only 1 per champion

DA_Artifact_RapidFireCannon.name: Rapid Firecannon
DA_Artifact_RapidFireCannon.desc: Gain +1 Attack Range, increased by 1 whenever the holder kills an enemy.

DA_Artifact_SeekersArmguard.name: Seeker's Armguard
DA_Artifact_SeekersArmguard.desc: Takedowns increase the holder’s Armor, Magic Resist, and Ability Power by 20.

DA_Artifact_SilvermereDawn.name: Silvermere Dawn
DA_Artifact_SilvermereDawn.desc: Grants immunity to Stuns and the holder's attacks Stun the target for 0.8 seconds. The holder’s Attack Speed is locked at 0.5.

DA_Artifact_StatikkShiv.name: Statikk Shiv
DA_Artifact_StatikkShiv.desc: Every 3rd attack deals 15 + 35% of the holder's Ability Power as additional magic damage to 6 enemies.

DA_Item_Artifact_TalismanOfAscension.name: Talisman of Ascension
DA_Item_Artifact_TalismanOfAscension.desc: After 22 seconds gain 100% max Health, 12 Mana Regen, and 120% Damage Amp for the rest of combat.

DA_Artifact_TheIndomitable.name: The Indomitable
DA_Artifact_TheIndomitable.desc: The holder's Move Speed is drastically reduced. Gain 15% max Health, Unstoppable, and pull the current target into melee range.

DA_Artifact_TitanicHydra.name: Titanic Hydra
DA_Artifact_TitanicHydra.desc: Attacks deal 2% of the holder's max Health plus 4% of their Attack Damage as bonus physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.

DA_Artifact_VoidGauntlet.name: Void Gauntlet
DA_Artifact_VoidGauntlet.desc: Combat Start: Store 30% max Health and 2.5% more every second. On death, unleash the stored Health as magic damage split between enemies within 4 hexes. Unique - only 1 per champion

DA_Artifact_WitsEnd.name: Wit's End
DA_Artifact_WitsEnd.desc: Attacks deal 25/45/65/85/100 bonus magic damage. Heals the holder for 25% of all magic damage dealt. Damage increases based on Stage.

DA_Artifact_ZhonyasParadox.name: Zhonya's Paradox
DA_Artifact_ZhonyasParadox.desc: Once per combat at 40% Health, become invulnerable and untargetable for 3 seconds. Unique - only 1 per champion

Elderwood Emblem.desc: The holder gains the Elderwood trait.

Defender Emblem.desc: The holder gains the Defender trait. Combat Start: Gain 6% Attack Speed for every ally that starts in the front row.

Invoker Emblem.desc: The holder gains the Invoker trait. On cast, gain Ability Power equal to 8% of Mana spent.

Spellweaver Emblem.desc: The holder gains the Spellweaver trait. Gain 2 Mana whenever an ally casts their Ability.

Hunter Emblem.desc: The holder gains the Hunter trait. Takedowns grant 18% Attack Damage.

Juggernaut Emblem.desc: The holder gains the Juggernaut trait. Gain 15 mana whenever a Juggernaut dies.
